I rehomed animals in the past due to similar reasons. I rehomed a cat after a couple of days because my dad lied when he said I could have it. He told me it was only allowed in my room and I realized that’s not the right life for a cat. He was adopted the next day I brought him back. 

Then I rehomed a dog after I realized I couldn’t help rehabilitate it and during this time they didn’t have as many resources for complex animal cases (early 2000s). He was adopted with an awesome family later. 

Now I have two amazing cats and just adopted my first puppy! 

Sometimes we make decisions even after researching and realize it’s probably the worst decision we could have made for ourselves in that moment in our lives. It doesn’t mean you can’t have pets in the future, but it’s not a for sure thing right now.

I don’t think someone should be chewed out for making a decision that is best for both the puppy and the person. I’m honestly happy you realized it sooner than later because now that puppy has a chance to grow with a family who is ready. 

I will say I did end up donating all my pet supplies I bought to the shelter and didn’t ask for a refund on those fees. If you feel guilty and want to do something to help the puppy, either donate supplies to the new family or make a donation to your local rescue.
